summary: ColorOS 17.0.0.152 移植版更新，修复亮度曲线问题
description:
OPPO Find X3 (PEDM00) 17.0.0.152

  • Synced to ColorOS 17.0.0.152 (PYB110 base, 2026-10-01).
  • Fixed the display brightness curve: the legacy two-column calibration is now mapped correctly, so the lowest brightness step stays visible instead of turning the panel off, and the low/mid-range progression matches the original C14 behaviour again.
  • Port compatibility fixes for the Find X3 kernel and vendor blobs.
  • Served by the community OTA metadata repo; the device keeps the stock ColorOS update UI.
